Scribble listing copy is not Apple Pencil hardware, Notes canvas, hover, or dictation

  • Dictation (different) — voice typing via microphone into text fields — not Apple Pencil handwriting conversion.
  • Custom keyboard (different) — third-party keyboard extensions and IME layouts — not Scribble in standard text fields.

What good zh-Hans Scribble listing copy looks like

Scribble-centric listings name the in-field conversion workflow in plain zh-Hans — not a word-for-word mirror of English brochure lines:

Does shipping Scribble support auto-translate my China listing?

No. Scribble and in-text-field handwriting are in-app or system-integrated features — they do not fill App Store Connect localization rows. If zh-Hans fields are empty, the China product page falls back to en-US copy.

The Apple Pencil listing guide covers stylus hardware, pairing, pressure, tilt, Works with Apple Pencil badges, and general Pencil drawing. This page covers Scribble handwriting-to-text in any text field (随手写) — scratch-out delete, circle-to-select, wait-to-convert, and keep handwriting vs convert.

How is this different from Notes or Quick Note listing copy?

Notes, Quick Note, Freeform, and Math Notes guides cover in-app canvas, capture, or equation-solving workflows — not system Scribble inside standard text fields. Link to those pages when canvas drawing is your lead story.

Is Scribble the same as Apple Pencil hover or dictation?

No. Hover preview shows content before the Pencil tip touches the screen — hardware marketing on the Apple Pencil page. Dictation converts speech to text via the microphone — covered on the Dictation listing page. Scribble converts Pencil handwriting to typed characters inside text fields.
